body: Built-in plugins: github (push/list/prune Actions secrets via gh, plus env-create, an idempotent PUT via gh api; scope flags --repo, --environment with --env alias, --org) and vercel (push/list/prune via the vercel CLI, --target multi-value, --sensitive, VERCEL_TOKEN banner labelling). Both put values on stdin, print the target and acting account, and prompt unless --yes.
